lines.text: Your product lives everywhere. Tickets. Pull requests. Test sheets. Customer notes. And none of it talks to each other.
Meet PM Agent. One intelligent layer that turns all of it into insight, decisions, and action.
Open it, and you already know what matters today. Every signal, with its source.
Ask anything. PM Agent reads your Jira, reasons it through, and shows you exactly how it found the answer.
Sprint health, at a glance. What's moving, what's stuck, and what's trending the wrong way.
Your QA sheet becomes a live release check. Ninety-six percent passing. Three blockers, named.
Run standup in one place. Who's in, what moved, what's blocked, and an AI summary of what needs you.
And the work that never makes it into Jira? Every follow-up, with an owner and a due date. Nothing slips.
Connect Jira, GitHub, and Gemini in minutes.
Then everything is one keystroke away.
And nothing touches Jira until you say so. PM Agent drafts. You decide.
Stories. PRDs. Feedback turned into work. All in your team's templates.
PM Agent. Connect everything. Understand anything. Move product forward.
